in_marathi.name: Kushwaha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kushwaha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kushwaha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kusha’ meaning ‘victorious, prosperous’ and ‘Waha’ meaning ‘he who resides’. This name is believed to have been given to those who were victorious in battle and chose to reside peacefully thereafter.
